runtimeGap: Verified on a live stack with Redis. Not covered: multi-instance Redis failover during the clear call, and refresh-token behaviour after the new login (the old refresh token is deleted by RevokeUserTokens and was not separately replayed).

commands.details: Clean build after adding ClearUserBlacklist and session-level markers in RevokeUserTokens.
Asserts user-level key, one session-level key per session, refresh-token cascade, and that another user's session is untouched.
Full MySQL/Redis-backed suite green after the change.
A3c: reset password -> new password logs in code=200; disable -> cannot log in; re-enable -> logs in code=200; session usable.
After reset: blacklist:<uid>=1 TTL 960s and blacklist:session:<sid>=1 TTL 960s. After the new login: user key gone, session key still 1. Old session 401 token.expired.force; new session 200.

knownGaps: The test-only PANTHEON_TEST_REDIS_DB switch was added so key-survival tests are not flushed by other packages under parallel `go test ./...`; default remains DB 1.
Refresh-token replay after reset is covered by the existing cascade test, not by the live probe.
